test_title: PYST 29: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.**

He says we are __poor__ now.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Opulent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Poor **means lacking wealth, and resources, or having a low income. It signifies a state of financial hardship or insufficiency. (धन और संसाधनों की कमी, या कम आय होना)

 
 
• **For example**: *Many people in the impoverished region live in poor conditions.* 
 
 
 
• Marked option **Opulent **means displaying great wealth, luxury, or abundance. It is often associated with extravagant and lavish lifestyles. (महान धन, विलासिता, या प्रचुरता प्रदर्शित करना)
 
 
• **For example**: *The opulent mansion was filled with valuable art and expensive furnishings.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the appropriate antonym for 'poor' is 'opulent.'

Hence, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indigent**: Extremely poor or impoverished; lacking the basic necessities of life. (अत्यंत गरीब या दरिद्र; जीवन की मूलभूत आवश्यकताओं का अभाव)
 
• **Ruined**: In a state of destruction, decay, or severe damage; often related to financial or personal collapse. (विनाश, क्षय, या गंभीर क्षति की स्थिति में; अक्सर वित्तीय या व्यक्तिगत पतन से संबंधित)
 
• **Barren**: Lacking vegetation or the ability to produce crops; unproductive or infertile. (वनस्पति या फसल पैदा करने की क्षमता का अभाव; अनुत्पादक या बांझ)
